sections.Profile:
A playable Guns N' Roses concert under glass, designed by Eric Meunier with Slash. Hype the crowd before the show, then start and complete as many GNR songs as possible: collect all seven band members to launch each one, from a setlist of 21 full-length studio master recordings that can all be played as multiball.

- Manufacturer: Jersey Jack Pinball
- Years made: 2020
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2020s, Licensed, Solid State, Band, Upper Playfield, Rock Music, Music
